notes.title: Game Adjustments
notes.content: [p]Some less user-friendly components have been changed to blue and purple, making the early game more accessible.[/p][p]An electromagnetic remote control component has been added to the white components, which allows bullets to orbit the player.[/p][p]Weapon damage has been increased overall, making the game easier.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693203/1ed14097a983c8943349d7b9af2bf27cbd3464e6.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Supplemented some game mechanics
notes.content: [p]In this patch, [b]physical weapons now consume ammo, and 100 rounds of bullets will be auto-purchased for 1 yuan[/b] to simplify resource management.[/p][p]To help players understand stats better, we [b]added some game attribute descriptions[/b] to the equipment interface.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693203/97427eca3bab056a523e386b9c7c14265dd02b09.png"][/img][/p]
